title: Uyirodu Uyiraga
desc: Ajay, a young man, is diagnosed with chronic brain tumour. He accepts his condition and lives a simple life, but Anjali, who loves his optimism, decides to lie to him in order to win his heart.

title: Aasaiyil Oru Kaditham
desc: Karthik unknowingly sends a love letter to Lakshmi, his friend Anand's fiancée. Subsequently, after their marriage, Anand suspects his wife of infidelity.

title: Anandhapurathu Veedu
desc: In order to escape from the loan sharks, Bala takes his wife and son to hide in his ancestral home. However, things turn eerie when he feels the presence of ghosts in the house.

title: Kattumarakaran
desc: A fisherman rescues a woman before she can commit suicide; they fall in love, but her rich father forbids their marriage, taking her away to be married to someone else.

title: Romeo Juliet
desc: Aishwarya falls in love with Karthik, thinking that he is a rich man. When she finds out that Karthik is actually poor, she breaks up with him.
